_comment: Worked example of a cutaway plan, and the shape the editing agent must emit. 'joins' are the jump cuts left behind by scripts/cut_silence.js — each cutaway snaps to the nearest one so it covers the artefact rather than sitting near it. '_line' records which line of the script the moment belongs to; it is documentation, not read by the tool. Rendered against reference/heygen/booth-rent-3-fix-the-paperwork-*.mp4, which is gitignored along with the rest of reference/.

cutaways._line: Most booth renters never separated the two
just you, and a pile of receipts
the lender doesn't see a business
a business account takes an afternoon
